name: 约翰诺·威尔逊
name_full: 约翰诺·威尔逊 Johnno Wilson
introduction: Johnno Wilson was born in New York City and raised in Shrewsbury, Massachusetts. He graduated from Georgetown University as an English Literature major and French minor, then worked as a professional consultant for several years. After auditioning for roles in Washington, DC, Wilson decided to move to Los Angeles, where he joined The Groundlings Troupe, and began taking acting classes. He met his wife, Anneliese van der Pol, by being cast as her ex-husband on her Disney show.
